csharp_prefer_braces #

Requires braces around embedded statements during formatting. The default true:none adds blocks even to single-line guards; severity does not disable formatting. false preserves existing braces and permits unbraced statements. when_multiline adds blocks when the formatted embedded statement spans multiple lines. Else-if chains remain chains. Formatter-off regions and statements crossing conditional directives are preserved. SK-DIV-0100: deliberately differs from the pinned oracle profiles, which do not insert braces under any value; retained at Tier D because this behavior is not oracle-conformant, with direct regression coverage in RequiredBracesTests.
